create_extractor_for_visualizer: create an extractor for a DensePose visualizer using create_extractor with the visualizer instance
extract_scores_from_instances: extract prediction scores from detectron2 Instances objects using extract_scores_from_instances
extract_boxes_xywh_from_instances: extract bounding boxes in XYWH format from detectron2 Instances using extract_boxes_xywh_from_instances
extract_densepose_results_with_confidenc: extract DensePose chart results with confidences using DensePoseResultExtractor on Instances
filter_instances_by_score_threshold: filter DensePose instances by minimum score using ScoreThresholdedExtractor with a threshold
